# Template: is_lm
The IS-LM diagram: output (Y) against the interest rate (r), a downward-sloping IS curve and an upward-sloping LM curve with their equilibrium computed exactly, dashed guides to both axes, and optional fiscal (IS) or monetary (LM) shifts drawn with a shift arrow and the new equilibrium. Choose this scene for ANY request about IS-LM, the goods and money markets together, fiscal policy or government spending shifting IS, monetary policy shifting LM, interest rates and output jointly, or the Keynesian short-run equilibrium. Paused, the viewer can drag IS or LM and the equilibrium recomputes live; an explore beat naming nothing hands it over. Values {is_lm.output}, {is_lm.rate}, {is_lm.output_new}, {is_lm.rate_new}.
Parameter schema:
{
 "type": "object",
 "properties": {
  "is_shift": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Horizontal IS shift in output units, -30..30 (positive = fiscal expansion, rightward; default 0)."
  },
  "lm_shift": {
   "type": "number",
   "description": "Horizontal LM shift in output units, -30..30 (positive = monetary expansion, rightward; default 0)."
  },
  "show_equilibrium": {
   "type": "boolean",
   "description": "Equilibrium dot with dashed guides to both axes and Y*/r* captions (default true)."
  },
  "title": {
   "type": "string"
  }
 }
}
Element ids your commands can reference:
- axes: the coordinate axes (a group with captions)
- is_curve: the IS curve with its end label
- lm_curve: the LM curve with its end label
- is_shifted: the shifted IS curve + shift arrow (a group, when is_shift ≠ 0)
- lm_shifted: the shifted LM curve + shift arrow (a group, when lm_shift ≠ 0)
- eq: the original equilibrium (dot + dashed guides + Y*/r* captions, a group)
- eq2: the new equilibrium after the shift (a group, when shifted)
- title: figure title, when set
Examples:
Request: "Draw the IS-LM diagram with its equilibrium." → params: {"title":"IS-LM equilibrium"}
Request: "Show a fiscal expansion in the IS-LM model." → params: {"is_shift":20,"title":"Fiscal expansion"}

Viewer can: Drag IS or LM sideways (fiscal or monetary policy); a shifted copy peels off the original and the equilibrium follows.

In YAML: `template: is_lm` and `params:` per the schema above; commands name the element ids above.
